_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail on the pattern of the Purpur egg (pelican-eggs' MohistMC egg was only read for reference): Mohist's launcher jar from MohistMC's API with the SHA-256 the API lists checked, latest is the Minecraft version MohistMC builds most recently, a version or build that does not exist fails the install. A hybrid (Forge mods and Bukkit plugins): the Minecraft tools without the version changer or modpacks. The eula flag (the panel asks the owner on the first start, nothing is pre-accepted), Java 21 to 8 images (Mohist's newest line, 1.20.1, runs on Java 17 and 21), Minecraft Java idle sleep, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: Mohist
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Mohist is a hybrid Minecraft Java server: Forge with Bukkit on top, so it runs Forge mods and Bukkit/Spigot plugins on one server.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Mohist installation (Octail): the server jar from MohistMC's API (api.mohistmc.com), its SHA-256 checked
# against the file_sha256 the API lists for the build. A version or build that doesn't exist fails the install
# instead of silently installing another one.
#
# Mohist is Forge with Bukkit (CraftBukkit/Spigot) on top: it runs Forge mods (mods/) and Bukkit plugins
# (plugins/). The jar is Mohist's launcher: on the first start it downloads Forge's libraries and the Minecraft
# server from MohistMC's mirrors, so the first start takes a few minutes.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu

API=https://api.mohistmc.com/project/mohist
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
BUILD="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 120 "$1"; }

case "${BUILD}" in
latest) ;;
'' | *[!0-9]*) fail "the build number (${BUILD}) must be a number or latest" ;;
esac

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

LIST=$(get "${API}/versions") || fail "can't reach MohistMC's API (${API}/versions)"
VERSIONS=$(echo "${LIST}" | jq -r '.[].name // empty')
[ -n "${VERSIONS}" ] || fail "MohistMC's API listed no Minecraft versions"

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
	# latest: the Minecraft version MohistMC built most recently (its maintained line, 1.20.1 in 2026),
	# not the highest number (1.20.2 and 1.21.x have old or no builds).
	DATES=""
	for v in ${VERSIONS}; do
		B=$(get "${API}/${v}/builds") || fail "can't list the builds of ${v}"
		DATE=$(echo "${B}" | jq -r 'map(.build_date // empty) | max // empty')
		[ -z "${DATE}" ] || DATES="${DATES}${DATE} ${v}
"
	done
	VERSION=$(printf '%s' "${DATES}" | sort -r | head -n 1 | cut -d ' ' -f 2)
	[ -n "${VERSION}" ] || fail "MohistMC has no builds for any Minecraft version"
	echo "Latest: Mohist builds ${VERSION} most recently."
fi
FOUND=0
for v in ${VERSIONS}; do
	if [ "${v}" = "${VERSION}" ]; then FOUND=1; fi
done
[ "${FOUND}" = 1 ] || fail "Mohist has no Minecraft ${VERSION}. The versions are: $(echo ${VERSIONS})"

BUILDS=$(get "${API}/${VERSION}/builds") || fail "can't list the builds of Mohist ${VERSION}"
if [ "${BUILD}" = "latest" ]; then
	BUILD=$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -r 'max_by(.id) | .id // empty')
	[ -n "${BUILD}" ] || fail "Mohist has no builds for ${VERSION} (yet). Pick another Minecraft version."
fi
INFO=$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -c --argjson b "${BUILD}" '.[] | select(.id == $b)')
[ -n "${INFO}" ] || fail "Mohist has no build ${BUILD} for ${VERSION}"
SHA=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.file_sha256 // empty' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
echo "${SHA}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' || fail "MohistMC's API gave no SHA-256 for build ${BUILD}"
FORGE=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.loader.forge_version // "?"')

echo "Installing Mohist ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} (Forge ${FORGE}) as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 900 -o "${JAR}.download" \
	"${API}/${VERSION}/builds/${BUILD}/download" || fail "the download of Mohist ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} failed"
GOT=$(sha256sum "${JAR}.download" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SHA}" ]; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "SHA-256 mismatch for Mohist ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} (expected ${SHA}, got ${GOT})"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"
mkdir -p mods plugins

echo "Mohist ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} installed (SHA-256 ${SHA} checked). Forge mods go in mods/, Bukkit plugins in plugins/."
echo "The first start downloads Forge's libraries and the Minecraft server, which takes a few minutes."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version to install, such as 1.20.1, or latest for the version MohistMC builds most recently (1.20.1 in 2026). A version Mohist has no build for fails the install.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 17 or 21 for 1.20.x, Java 17 for 1.18 and 1.19, Java 8 or 11 for 1.16.5, Java 8 for 1.12.2 and 1.7.10.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: The Mohist build to install, or latest for the newest build of that Minecraft version.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file (Mohist's launcher).
